verdict.rationale: The docs show project-local skills living in the repo at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, and the Agent SDK describes skills as filesystem artifacts. Cross-project reuse is only implied by plugins being "reusable across projects" and "shared across projects and teams"; the pack never documents a user-global skills location or an explicit scope choice at install time. Missing for 10: documented user-global skills directory (e.g. a home-directory path), explicit install-scope selection for plugins/skills (user vs project), guidance on committing project skills to the repo, independent corroboration.
